question: Do frozen Ca_HVA gate primitives remain accurate in a causal voltage-gate-current loop when the authentic channel measurably affects voltage?
parent_result: giada-task7-microcanary-v1; solver calibrated, but channel current was effectively silent
teacher: same authentic compiled Ca_HVA.mod, one 10 x 10 um compartment, pas, fixed E_Ca=120 mV, dt=0.025 ms
negative_control: gbar=0; matched current injection but no Ca_HVA feedback

exposure_gate.policy: A pair must satisfy both thresholds; report all eight initial-voltage/protocol pairs, never select a dose using candidate errors.

selection: No retraining, no model/seed selection, no threshold adjustment; all arms share teacher initial state and external current schedule, then use their own causal voltage.
limits: Single compartment only; E_Ca held fixed; no synapses, axial currents, other channels, calcium dynamics or trained voltage network. The 4x conductance is a diagnostic stress, not canonical biology.
